entities.summary: Tan Sri Loke Wan Tho was a Malaysian business magnate, ornithologist, and photographer. He was the founder of Cathay Organisation in Singapore and Malaysia and the chairman of Cathay Organisation, which included Cathay Cinemas and Cathay-Keris Film Productions. He was associated with the Motion Picture and General Investments Limited (MP&GI) in Hong Kong. Loke Wan Tho was a painters & sculptors from Kuala Lumpur (1915-06-14, Kuala Lumpur–1964-06-20). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
